# OptmizeImage

> Free online image compression and optimization tools for compressing, resizing, and converting images while maintaining good visual quality.

OptmizeImage is a browser-based image optimization platform that helps users reduce image file sizes, compress JPG and PNG images, resize images, convert JPG to WebP, and compress images to specific file-size targets such as 100KB, 200KB, and 500KB.

## Tools

* [OptmizeImage Image Compressor](https://www.optmizeimage.com/) — Free online image compression and optimization tool.
* [Compress JPG](https://www.optmizeimage.com/tools/compress-jpg.html) — Compress JPG/JPEG images online.
* [Compress PNG](https://www.optmizeimage.com/tools/compress-png.html) — Compress PNG images online.
* [Resize Image](https://www.optmizeimage.com/tools/resize-image.html) — Resize images to specific dimensions.
* [JPG to WebP](https://www.optmizeimage.com/tools/jpg-to-webp.html) — Convert JPG images to WebP format.
* [Compress Image to 100KB](https://www.optmizeimage.com/tools/compress-to-100kb.html) — Compress an image to approximately 100KB.
* [Compress Image to 200KB](https://www.optmizeimage.com/tools/compress-to-200kb.html) — Compress an image to approximately 200KB.
* [Compress Image to 500KB](https://www.optmizeimage.com/tools/compress-to-500kb.html) — Compress an image to approximately 500KB.

## Capabilities

OptmizeImage provides tools for:

* Image compression
* JPG/JPEG compression
* PNG compression
* Image resizing
* JPG to WebP conversion
* Compression to approximately 100KB
* Compression to approximately 200KB
* Compression to approximately 500KB
* Website image optimization
* Image file-size reduction
* Image format optimization

## Website Performance

Image optimization can help reduce page weight and may contribute to faster page loading and improved web performance. Image compression should be balanced with visual quality and the requirements of the target use case.

## Privacy and Processing

Users should refer to the OptmizeImage privacy policy for current information about how image processing and user data are handled.
